gates.title: Release input packaging is read-only
gates.evidence: This report reads prestaging handoff, candidate-ref proof, and NAS image proof JSON only; it does not contact NAS, Docker, GitHub, Admin API, or Cutter.

gates.title: Pre-staging handoff report is provided
gates.required_evidence: Run validate:admin-docker-prestaging-handoff and provide the JSON report path.

gates.title: Candidate ref proof report is provided
gates.required_evidence: Run validate:admin-docker-candidate-ref-proof with the candidate tag push_images=false GitHub dry-run artifacts.

gates.title: NAS image proof report is provided
gates.required_evidence: Run validate:admin-docker-nas-image-proof with exported NAS .env and docker inspect evidence.

gates.title: Handoff is ready to request release inputs
gates.required_evidence: Pre-staging handoff must have ready_to_request_release_inputs=true.

gates.title: Handoff still does not approve staging or deploy
gates.required_evidence: Release input packaging must be based on a non-deploy pre-staging handoff.

gates.title: Candidate ref proof is accepted
gates.required_evidence: Candidate ref proof must verify that the release tag points to the smoked candidate SHA and has a successful push_images=false dry-run.

gates.title: Candidate ref proof does not approve deploy
gates.required_evidence: Candidate ref proof must remain evidence-only with docker_deploy_allowed=false.

gates.title: Candidate ref target matches handoff target
gates.required_evidence: The candidate-ref proof expected SHA must match the pre-staging handoff target image tag.

gates.title: Candidate ref tag matches workflow ref
gates.required_evidence: The candidate-ref proof expected tag must match the generated workflow ref.

gates.title: Pre-staging execution blockers are carried forward
gates.required_evidence: The release-input package must preserve pre-staging blockers so a generated push_images=true command is not mistaken for staging approval.

gates.title: Legacy latest rollback exception plan is provided when needed
gates.required_evidence: When the current NAS stack is legacy latest, provide an accepted admin-docker-legacy-rollback-plan report.

gates.title: Legacy latest rollback exception evidence is ready
gates.required_evidence: Legacy rollback plan must be ready, current must be latest, target must match the handoff target, and only release-decision blockers may remain.

gates.title: Legacy rollback plan does not approve release or deploy
gates.required_evidence: The legacy rollback plan must remain review-only with release_execution_allowed=false and docker_deploy_allowed=false.

gates.title: Release-manager exception review is accepted when provided
gates.required_evidence: Provide an accepted admin-docker-legacy-rollback-exception-review report with reviewer.role=release-manager, current=latest, matching target, and no review blockers.

gates.title: Release-manager exception review does not approve release or deploy
gates.required_evidence: The exception review must be limited to release-input generation and keep release_execution_allowed=false plus docker_deploy_allowed=false.

gates.title: Release-manager accepted the one-time legacy latest rollback exception
gates.required_evidence: Provide an accepted release-manager exception review report, or set MIXLAB_DOCKER_LEGACY_ROLLBACK_EXCEPTION_APPROVAL only as an explicit fallback.

gates.title: NAS current image proof is accepted
gates.required_evidence: NAS image proof must accept a stable current image tag for current and rollback inputs.

gates.title: NAS image proof does not approve deploy
gates.required_evidence: NAS image proof must remain evidence-only with docker_deploy_allowed=false.

gates.title: Target image tag is present
gates.required_evidence: Pre-staging handoff must include release_input_request.target_image_tag.

gates.title: Workflow ref pins the target candidate image
gates.required_evidence: Use a release tag named admin-docker-candidate-<target SHA> so workflow_dispatch --ref cannot drift with the branch.

gates.title: Release ref setup command pins candidate SHA
gates.required_evidence: Pre-staging handoff must provide a reproducible git tag + push command for the candidate release ref.

gates.title: Current and rollback tags are present
gates.required_evidence: NAS image proof must provide current_image_tag and rollback_image_tag.

gates.title: Rollback tag matches current deployed tag
gates.required_evidence: Rollback tag must match current image tag for the first Admin Docker update.

gates.title: Target tag differs from current deployed tag
gates.required_evidence: Target image tag must differ from the currently deployed Admin Docker tag.

gates.title: Workflow command has concrete image tags
gates.evidence: gh workflow run docker-admin.yml --repo alin155/mixlab --ref admin-docker-candidate-9c015b9105e97954240020781f79daae3f954bde -f push_images=true -f current_image_tag=9c015b9105e97954240020781f79daae3f954bde -f rollback_image_tag=9c015b9105e97954240020781f79daae3f954bde
gates.required_evidence: Provide accepted NAS image proof before generating the workflow command.

gates.title: Explicit release approval is still required
gates.evidence: This report prepares release inputs only; it is not approval to run push_images=true.
gates.required_evidence: A separate human release decision must explicitly authorize running the generated push_images=true command.

next_actions: Keep push_images=false until release inputs are ready.
Preserved pre-staging execution blockers: nas-disk-risk-carried-forward, explicit-push-approval-required, current-and-rollback-tags-required.

result.summary: Release inputs are blocked until pre-staging handoff, candidate-ref proof, NAS image proof, and any required legacy rollback exception review are accepted.
